The fracture was not a classical soft tissue Chance fracture, as it disrupted the posterior elements at T7/8, and the intervertebral disc at the level below (Figure 1). There was, therefore, some bony involvement, with the fracture passing through the lamina of T8 (Figure 3). panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (a, b). a: Panel (a) is a 3D reconstructed CT image clearly showing kyphoscoliosis, which is the clinical manifestation of the pediatric Chance fracture reported in the article. b: Panel (b) is an axial CT slice showing the specific injury pattern of a horizontal split/opening of bilateral Y-shaped cartilage, which corresponds to a Chance-type fracture involving the pedicles.
